entities.summary: Inga Bejer Engh is a Norwegian jurist, former prosecutor, and Children's ombudsman between 2018 and 2024. Together with Svein Holden she prosecuted terror suspect Anders Behring Breivik in the 2012 trial following the 2011 Norway attacks.
